parameters.help_en: The name of the project. The model belongs to the project, and one project corresponds to one model
parameters.help_zh: Project 名称。模型归属于该 Project，一个 Project 对应一个模型
parameters.name: project

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the number of elements and the modeling task status for the model in the project
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回该 Project 模型的元素数量与建模任务状态

elementCount.description_en: The number of elements in the current model. The value is less than the final value while modeling is in progress and may be 0 when the task is initially submitted
elementCount.description_zh: 当前模型包含的元素数量。建模仍在进行时会小于最终值，刚提交任务时可能为 0

taskState.description_en: The status of the most recent modeling task. Valid values: pending (Queued), running (Generating), succeeded (Completed), failed (Failed), and none (No corresponding task exists and the model has no data)
taskState.description_zh: 最近一次建模任务的状态：pending（排队中）、running（生成中）、succeeded（已结束）、failed（失败）、none（没有对应任务且模型没有数据）
